citations.field: 問 entry; PDF page 95, printed page 83; inspected source scan at /home/catalin/hanzi-etymology-books/research-ocr/ziyuan-full/page-0095/source.png (decoded RGB pixel SHA-256 6a503d540e575979551067d0fb9815720e3fd55edd7b3a99645f59fa5753d682)
citations.text: Direct inspection of the scan confirms the 問(问) wèn headword and its paragraph: the entry says 形聲字，从口，門聲; gives “本义是问讯、询问”; says the oracle-bone form had appeared but its meaning was unclear; notes bronze and Warring States seal uses as a personal name; and lists extensions from inquiry including 问难、过问、审问、责问、访问、慰问、打听, plus a 通闻 use. The passage ends on this page. The facing/top of the next page begins separate 口 entries, not a continuation. The OCR excerpt agrees with the inspected print for this passage.
